fields.name: num
fields.coerce: `to_number`: `round(parseInt(num))`. A negative value, a missing value or `NaN` becomes 0, so the server uses slot 0

fields.name: slot
fields.description: The target slot. An open trade slot (`trade1` to `trade30`, see `get_trade_slots`) with no `consume` selects the variant Trade listing: the item goes on your stand. Any other value (or none) selects the variant Use or equip.

fields.name: consume
fields.description: Any truthy value. The server skips the trade listing and the gear path: only potions, elixirs, `cxjar`, licences and spawners work (the variant Use or equip).

confirm.note: The handler reads `num`, `slot`, `consume`, and in the trade path `price`, `q`, `want`, `giveaway`, `minutes`

list.name: Trade listing
list.match: `slot` is an open trade slot, and no `consume`
list.when: Lists the item on your merchant stand, for gold, as a swap offer (`want`) or as a giveaway.

fields.name: slot
fields.description: An open trade slot (`trade1` to `trade30`, see `get_trade_slots`).

fields.name: consume
fields.description: Absent or a false value. A true value selects the variant Use or equip.

fields.name: price
fields.coerce: `round(min(99999999999, max(parseInt(price) || 1, 1)))`: a string works, a fraction goes away, 0 and `NaN` become 1
fields.description: The gold for each unit, 1 to 99,999,999,999. The server uses 1 for a giveaway.

fields.name: q
fields.description: How many units of the stack to list. It is not clamped to the stack: a larger value fails with `not_enough`.

fields.name: want
fields.coerce: `trade_want_normalize` (see `TradeWant`). Any value other than `undefined` counts as present, also `null`
fields.description: List the item as a swap offer for this item, not for gold. A string is the same as `{name}`.

fields.name: giveaway
fields.description: Any truthy value lists the item as a giveaway.

fields.name: minutes
fields.description: Giveaway only: the duration in minutes, 5 to 600.

responses.name: Listed
responses.when: A stack moves `q` units into a new item in the slot. Another item moves whole. The slot item gets `price` (or `want`) and a random 4-character `rid`. A giveaway also gets `giveaway: minutes` and `list: []`.

rows.when: `q` is more than the units of the item (`q || 1`).
Not a giveaway: `want` does not name an item of `G.items` (or names `placeholder`), or its `p` is not a key of `G.titles`.
The trade slot holds an item already (a listing, or a wishlist entry with `b`). The code has this spelling.

also.when: The listing text, before the `player` update. The phrase is `server.game_log.listed_at_gold_each` (a stack), `listed_at_gold` (one item), `listed_to_giveaway` or `listed_to_giveaway_2` (a giveaway), or `offered_for` or `offered_for_or_higher` (a swap).

list.name: Use or equip
list.when: Uses the item (elixir, `cxjar`, licence, spawner, potion) or, without `consume`, equips it. The type of the item picks the path.

fields.name: slot
fields.description: The equipment slot, for example `"mainhand"` or `"ring1"`. When absent, the server uses the type of the item. Only the gear path reads it.

responses.name: Equipped
responses.when: Gear: `can_equip_item` accepts the item for the slot. The server swaps it with the item in the slot (a displaced item with `b` is deleted), and adds 120 ms to `penalty_cd` (at most 120,000 ms).

fields.name: slot
fields.description: The equipment slot that got the item. It can differ from `slot` in the request, for example `weapon` becomes `mainhand` or `offhand`.

responses.name: Elixir
responses.when: The item is of type `elixir`. The server puts it in `slots.elixir` with `expires`. The same elixir again sets the time left to the full duration plus 97.5% of the old time left. An old elixir with `withdrawal` gives you that condition. A new elixir with `withdrawal` removes the condition `withdrawal`.

responses.name: Potion
responses.when: The item has `gives` (a potion). The server adds each `[stat, amount]` of `gives` to you, at least 1 for each stat. `poisoned` halves the amounts. A `debuff` potion also removes the debuff conditions. The potion cooldown starts: `def.cooldown`, else 2,000 ms, or 0.1 ms for an XP potion.

responses.name: Used
responses.when: `cxjar` (adds the cosmetic in `data`), an item of type `licence` (adds 7 minutes to `licenced`), or an item of type `spawner` (spawns the trap monster `spawn` at your position, with you as owner). The server removes one unit.

fields.name: acx
fields.description: All your cosmetics now: name to count.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The cosmetic from `data` of the jar.

rows.when: Elixir: the item has the lock `l`.
`cxjar`: the jar has no `data`, or it has the lock `l`.
Licence: the item has the lock `l`.
Potion: the item has the lock `l`.
Gear: `can_equip_item` refuses the item for the slot. For a two-handed weapon while you hold an offhand item, a `game_log` comes first.
`consume` is set and the item is none of the kinds above.

also.when: Gear: before `cant_equip`, when the slot is `weapon`, `mainhand` or `tool`, you hold an offhand item, and the item is a two-handed weapon for your class.

example.message: Unequip your offhand item to use this two-handed weapon.

also.summary: `{message, x, y, id, args: {c, s}}` over your character: `"+200"` for HP (a negative amount without `+`), `"+<amount>"` for MP, `"+1M"` for XP (with `sz: "large"`).

confirm.note: For a negative HP amount `message` is the number itself, not a string

fields.name: code
fields.description: `"pot_timeout(<ms>)"`: the cooldown for the official client. For an XP potion it is `pot_timeout(120)`.

order: a potion: `disappearing_text` to clients nearby and `eval` to you; a `cxjar`: `game_response` `cx_new` to you

rows.when: `num` is the inventory length or more. The server stopped your channeled actions (`c`) already.
The item is a placeholder: an upgrade or compound runs on the slot.
`want` is present, and `consume` is set or `slot` is not an open trade slot.

also.summary: Your state with `reopen: true`. The server recalculates your stats, except for a potion that gives no XP.
